name: Anisha Bora

education.institution: Ishan Institute of Management and Technology

responsibilities: Led a team of 10 recruiters delivering end-to-end IT hiring (C2H/FTE) for enterprise clients including KPMG India, EY India, EY GDS, Wipro, Genpact, Incedo, HCL, Accenture, Infosys BPM, and Kyndryl, as well as internal hiring.
Acted in a client‑facing Account Management role, resolving escalations such as delayed interview feedback and rejected offers.
Designed and implemented master tracking dashboards covering submission pipeline, interview scheduling, rejection analysis, and turnaround time.

Reduced sourcing cycle time and improved profile‑to‑shortlist conversion rates by leveraging AI tools (Chat GPT, Claude, Gemini) for JD creation, candidate fitment analysis, and sourcing optimization.
Partnered daily with BU Heads, Directors, and Hiring Managers (India/US) to align hiring priorities, execute business development plans, and identify new revenue opportunities.
Managed full‑cycle recruitment for permanent and contractual roles, including intake calls, sourcing, pre‑screening, technical interview coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding.

Built talent networks via cold calling, referrals, job portals, and headhunting, delivering lateral and leadership hiring across Cloud architecture, Product Development, BFSI, Insurance Network engineering, mobile, web application, and Cyber security compliance.
Authored and delivered weekly recruitment reports covering sourcing metrics, conversion, selection, and joiners to leadership and client stakeholders.

experiences.role: Associate Principal Consultant (Team Lead & Individual Contributor)
responsibilities: Balanced people development with hands‑on execution; managed a team of recruiters while personally owning end‑to‑end closure of critical, niche, and leadership mandates.
Acted in a client‑facing Account Management role, swiftly resolving escalations such as delayed interview feedback and rejected offers.

Delivered permanent and contract IT recruitment for 7+ years across strategic accounts including Genpact, Fujitsu, HCL, Accenture, Tredence Analytics, Coforge, Wipro, Barco Electronics, EY India, Happiest Minds, DLT Labs, Persistent, Magic Bricks, Times Internet, L&T, Capgemini, and UHG, as well as in‑house hiring.

Led leadership hiring across specialized IT infrastructure domains (Cloud architecture, Product Development, BFSI, Insurance Network engineering, mobile, web application, and Cybersecurity compliance).
Managed full‑lifecycle technical hiring, partnering with business heads for intake, assessing technical competencies, and ensuring adherence to strict hiring TATs.
Established workforce planning discipline by tracking team KPIs (TAT, offer‑to‑join ratio, cost‑per‑hire) and presenting analytics and hiring recommendations to HR leadership.
Owned high‑stakes salary negotiations, notice‑period management, and onboarding facilitation to maximize offer‑to‑join conversion rates.
Championed candidate experience through structured communication across the hiring lifecycle, minimizing offer declines and drop‑outs.
Optimized internal recruiting processes and trained junior recruiters on best‑practice sourcing, assessment frameworks, and ATS utilization.
Represented Talent Acquisition in leadership forums, providing market intelligence on candidate availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitive landscape.
Managed recruitment budgets, cost approvals, reference checks, and offer letter generation.

profile_summary: Technical Recruitment Manager with 8+ years of progressive experience in IT talent acquisition, team leadership, and strategic hiring for global technology organizations. Proven track record leading teams of 8+ recruiters to deliver high-volume technical hiring across BFSI, Cloud, Healthcare, consulting verticals and in‑house hirings. Functions as a strategic bridge between enterprise IT clients and internal sourcing teams. Adept at reducing sourcing cycle times through AI tool adoption, building scalable recruiting processes, and driving measurable improvements in offer‑to‑join conversion rates. Skilled in workforce planning, headcount forecasting, stakeholder management, and data‑driven recruitment strategy within fast‑paced, matrixed environments.
